cross_verification.note_en: Moldova's short-stay (type C) entry visa uses the EU/Schengen-format uniform application form, confirmed by direct retrieval and full-text extraction of mfa.gov.md/sites/default/files/visa-application-form_0.pdf. The form includes a designated 'PHOTO' box and a declaration that 'the taking of my photograph... [is] mandatory for the examination of the visa application,' but the extracted form text does not state explicit photo dimensions or background color (these are typically shown only as a graphical placeholder on the printed form, not as text). The application is processed via mfa.gov.md, Moldovan diplomatic missions, or the e-Visa portal at evisa.gov.md; a direct fetch of evisa.gov.md failed with a TLS certificate error in this session. No page stating specific cm/background values for the visa photo (as opposed to the separate passport photo, see md-passport) could be confirmed, so all spec fields are left unverified rather than assumed to match the passport standard.
